observationLimit: Submission response listener had a local URL-global error after the single click; no resubmission was attempted. The redirected browser page and independent GET200 with matching heading confirm under-review acknowledgement.

alternativeTo.rule: Email verification is required before a new app can be submitted. Public/open beta may qualify; early access/private beta/invite-only/coming-soon apps are excluded.
alternativeTo.maturityNote: QuickVoice is publicly source-available and pre-stable; pre-stable is not by itself proof of ineligibility. Any submission must truthfully represent publicly runnable status, not rename it to bypass the criteria.

submissionTimeNote: The exact POST timestamp was not retained by the failed response observer; the single submission had completed by the acknowledgement screenshot timestamp.
